description: Fires mostly in the opening (about 4-10 stones) right after the opponent plays on the right edge (column 6), or less often column 3/5, especially when the opponent has stones in columns 3 and 6 and I have none in columns 4-5. My stones in column 4 (and 5) suppress it, as does an opponent stone stacked on an existing stone in column 4 or 5; it fades as the game gets longer. Many firings fit no clean rule.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by less than 0.01 on 5 tested positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit. Minimal pairs show an order-dependent additive mix of (player, column) tokens: last move col 6 best, my col-4 stones about -0.5 at ply 8, stacking on col 4/5 kills it, decays with ply. Weights are not stable across plies. Best dev F1 0.367 (P .36, R .37, AUROC .675), simulation share 0.08. A simple rule (ply<=10, last col 6, no my col-4 stone) got F1 0.29. Possibly a random direction.
